title: paces: Parallelized Application of Co-Evolving Subspaces, a method for computing quantum dynamics on GPUs
summary: An efficient method of solving the time-dependent Schrödinger equation for pure states is described: At each timestep, a restricted subspace of the total Hilbert space is systematically and naturally constructed via the image of repeated applications of the Hamiltonian operator, and the time evolution is computed exactly within said subspace. The subspace is dynamically recomputed such that it co-evolves with the state vector.
